name: nones-mcp-workspace
description: Bun Workspaces prototype and migration spec for the @nones MCP server suite

scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/core build && bun run --cwd apps/kaiten build && bun run --cwd apps/opencode build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/core typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/kaiten typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/opencode typecheck
scripts.verify: bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run pack:check
